Name: Tsum Tsum Script - BETA
Message:
**Changes**
1. Debug tab: a Detect MyTsum button reads which tsum the pre-round screen shows selected, without playing a round.
2. The selected tsum is named as the running game prints it: in English on the international game, in Japanese on the Japan game.
3. Auto launch finds the Japan game on its own: whichever build is installed is the one started, so nothing has to be set for it. The stats CSV gains a `build` column.

_Testing build -- please report anything odd._
